verdict.rationale: The x402 discovery docs mention searching and listing Bazaar resources "with a generated OpenAPI client", which implies an OpenAPI spec exists for the discovery API. However, no downloadable spec URL is documented, and probing common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs domain returned 404. The probe covered guessed locations only, so it is not a concrete contradiction of any vendor claim. missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec location, spec coverage beyond the Bazaar discovery API (e.g. facilitator verify/settle endpoints), and hands-on confirmation that the spec can be fetched.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Search and list resources with a generated OpenAPI client.
